units.source_text: 源氏谈起旧事来，对柏木说道：“

en.t: Genji began speaking of old times and said to Kashiwagi, "

units.source_text: 你家太政大臣年轻时候，无论何事都要和我争个胜负。

en.t: When the Grand Minister of your family was young, he tried to compete with me in everything.

units.source_text: 就中只有蹴鞠一事，我总赶不上他。

en.t: Among them, kemari was the one thing in which I could never catch up with him.

units.source_text: 此种微末之事，想来不须家传，然而你家确有这种优良传统。

en.t: One might think such a trivial skill hardly needs to be handed down in a family, yet your house truly has this fine tradition.

units.source_text: 像你这种好本领，我从来不曾见过呢！”

en.t: I have never seen anyone with such splendid skill as yours."

units.source_text: 我家家风，都不讲究真才实学，只在这种方面保持传统，

en.t: In my family, we pay little attention to real talent or learning and keep our traditions only in matters like this,

units.source_text: 将来子孙定然一无所成吧。”

en.t: so our descendants will surely accomplish nothing at all."

units.source_text: 无论何事，但凡超群出众的，都有传世的价值。

en.t: No matter what it is, anything that stands out above the rest is worth passing down to later generations.

units.source_text: 你们的蹴鞠技术也可记录在家传里，后人看了一定深感兴趣。”

en.t: Your kemari skills could also be recorded in the family tradition, and later readers would surely find them deeply interesting."

units.source_text: 他用游戏语调说这话，那姿态神情异常优越。

en.t: He said this in a playful tone, and his bearing and expression were extraordinarily distinguished.

units.source_text: 嫁得这样一个美男子，恐怕无论如何也不会把心移向别的男子了。

en.t: Having married such a handsome man, she would probably never turn her heart toward another man, no matter what happened.

units.source_text: 我有何德何能，可使三公主心悦诚服地爱我呢？”

en.t: What virtue or ability do I have that could make the Third Princess love me sincerely and wholeheartedly?"

units.source_text: 便觉自己的身份与三公主相去遥远，不敢高攀。

en.t: He then felt that his own rank was far removed from the Third Princess's and did not dare aspire so high.

units.source_text: 他带着满怀幽恨，退出六条院去。

en.t: With his heart full of hidden bitterness, he withdrew from the Rokujo estate.
